title: East TN TACN sample
notes: TN Interop names (TN CALL, TN IO 1–15) are talkgroups on TACN, not standalone frequencies.
Enter a nearby site control channel (CC) in MHz on the SDR page; decode events show the TGID.
One RTL-SDR typically listens to one trunked system at a time. For Sullivan County radios use Sullivan Co Simulcast (site 50, LSM).
GPS is not a talkgroup — it appears only if a radio sends Motorola unit location on the locked site.
Frequencies change — re-check RadioReference SID 6355 if CC lock fails. NAC for site 50 is 2AC (corrected Dec 2025).
Skip Bays Mountain (site 231) — RadioReference wiki treats those frequencies as stale.
Only monitor systems you own, administer, or are explicitly authorized to monitor.

systems.name: TACN Elizabethton
systems.modulation_note: Standalone 800 MHz — use P25 (C4FM). RR notes 854.4375 is primary.

systems.name: TACN Buffalo Mtn
systems.modulation_note: Simulcast — use P25 LSM (CQPSK). Second dongle, or instead of Elizabethton.

systems.name: TACN Fall Branch
systems.modulation_note: 700 MHz fallback if 800 MHz is weak.

systems.name: TACN Sullivan Co Simulcast
systems.modulation_note: 800 MHz 4-site county simulcast — use P25 LSM (CQPSK), not C4FM. NAC 2AC. GPS from Sullivan/Bristol/Kingsport radios is heard here, not on Elizabethton.
